about.intro: A personal database for organizing and managing a Bearbrick collection by series and category.
about.feature1: Browse bearbricks organized by series and category
about.feature2: View product details (release date, description, images)
about.feature3: Sign in to submit a correction request for any listing
about.feature4: Admin bulk add/update support via Excel
about.foundWrongBody: Anyone can sign in and request a correction from a product's detail page. Requests are reviewed by an admin before they take effect.
about.contactBody: For bug reports, suggestions, or anything else, reach out at <email>my@favorite.kr</email>.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: GomBrick ("we", "the service") respects your privacy. This page explains what information we collect, how we use it, and who to contact with questions.
privacy.section1Body: When you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email address, and profile picture. If you use the app, you may also provide a display nickname, the bearbricks in your personal collection, images you upload, and correction or suggestion requests you submit.
privacy.section2Body: We use this information to authenticate your account, save your personal collection, let admins review your submissions and correction requests, and — only if you opt in — display your nickname as credit on content you submit.
privacy.section3Body: We use Google Sign-In for authentication and Vercel for hosting, file storage, and anonymized usage analytics. These providers process data on our behalf under their own privacy policies.
privacy.section4Body: We retain your account data while your account is active. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time by contacting us below.
privacy.section5Body: GomBrick is not directed at children under 14, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.
privacy.section6Body: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the effective date above.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about this policy or your data? Reach out at <email>my@favorite.kr</email>.
